metadata.title: Security Assessment Results - Trusted Cloud (Envoke)
metadata.remarks: Platform-level Trusted Cloud assessment for Envoke. Findings reflect declared observability and integration governance limitations; strong tenant isolation, data residency, and assurance posture are confirmed.

findings.title: Limited Log Exportability for Correlation
findings.description: The Envoke platform provides tenant-visible administrative action logs and campaign telemetry within each account, but does not currently support export of these logs for external correlation or SIEM ingestion.

associated-risk.title: Limited Centralized Correlation
associated-risk.description: Inability to export logs limits centralized correlation with other security telemetry and may increase investigation effort during incidents.

findings.title: Single Per-Account API Key with Tenant-Wide Rotation Impact
findings.description: Each Envoke account uses a single API key for all data and application integrations. The key may be retrieved by certain non-administrative roles, and rotation invalidates all integrations for the account simultaneously.

associated-risk.title: Integration Blast Radius and Rotation Risk
associated-risk.description: A single shared API key increases blast radius in the event of compromise and complicates safe, staged key rotation without service disruption.

remediations.title: Introduce Log Export and Security API
remediations.description: Provide a provider-supported security API to enable extraction of administrative and campaign telemetry for external correlation and SIEM integration.

tasks.title: Deliver Security Logging API
tasks.description: Implement a security API to allow customers to programmatically retrieve logs for correlation and monitoring.

remediations.title: Improve API Key Management Granularity
remediations.description: Enhance API credential management to support per-integration keys, restricted visibility, and staged rotation to reduce disruption and blast radius.

tasks.title: Support Per-Integration API Keys
tasks.description: Enable multiple API keys per account scoped to individual integrations.

tasks.title: Restrict API Key Visibility
tasks.description: Limit retrieval of API credentials to administrative roles only.
